page.overview:
Who is Curtis Uleas?

was the Holy Curator of the temple of the Lawbearer in Vasselheim in 812 PD. As an NPC, is played by Matthew Mercer.

Curtis was squat, bald, and mousey-looking.

In 812 PD, Holy Curator Curtis Uleas is mentioned as the representative of the Quadroads of Erathis in a meeting to discuss how to stop Vecna's march on Vasselheim. He objected to Allura Vysoren's offer to transport a strike team to Thar Amphala.

In 843 PD, Curtis Uleas was not mentioned as the Holy Curator at the meeting of the Exandrian Accord in Vasselheim after the fall of the base of the Bloody Bridge in the Hellcatch Valley of Marquet. At that time, there was a Holy Curator named Adona., a figure steps forward identified first as "High Curator Adona" and then as "Holy Curator" and expresses very similar sentiments as the person in the previous episode.}}
